messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

The damage included tissue death (necrosis) and gangrene.
The damage has needed surgery to treat.

Others may happen.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["tissue damage", "requires treatment with", "surgery"]

The relation 'requires treatment with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or entity necessitates the medical intervention or treatment specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has treatment requirement': The medical condition specified by the subject requires the treatment or management approach specified by the object entity.
B. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has use indication': The subject drug may be used for the medical purpose or indication specified by the object entity.
E. 'must be used in combination with': The subject drug must be used in conjunction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity for the indicated medical condition.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
